474:t_030:6.en:
$$隼人$$
「Heh... That's awfully modest of you, coming from you.」

474:t_030:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Just so you know, $$隼人$$, my first impression of you was the worst.」

474:t_030:9.en:
$$竜馬$$
「But once I got to know you, you turned out not to be such a bad guy.」

474:t_030:10.en:
$$隼人$$
「What a coincidence. I thought exactly the same thing about you.」

474:t_030:11.en:
$$弁慶$$
「So in the end, you're two of a kind!」

474:t_030:12.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That's how it is, $$インベーダー#pilot$$s! Living like this is a lot more fun than picking fights with everyone in sight!」

474:t_030:14.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「We are the living things chosen by the $$ゲッター線$$! We are the one and only victors of this universe!」

474:t_030:15.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Then quit the blabbering and hurry up and send in your pet monsters. I'll smash every last one of them until there's not a trace left!」

474:t_030:16.en:
$$隼人$$
「Heh... Hard to believe you were unconscious just a little while ago.」

474:t_030:17.en:
$$弁慶$$
「You said it, so show us, $$竜馬$$!」

474:t_030:18.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Of course! Let's go, you guys!」

474:t_030:20.en:
$$葵$$
「Let's push them back all at once from here!」

474:t_030:21.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Hold on, $$インベーダー#pilot$$s! $$流竜馬$$, your natural enemy, is coming for you now!!」

474:t_031:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$コーウェン$$, $$スティンガー$$. Are you two coming next?」

474:t_031:1.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「...Unfortunately, it seems we cannot defeat you as we are now.」

474:t_031:2.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「We will be waiting in the galaxy, $$流竜馬$$. We will settle everything there.」

474:t_032:1.en:
$$渓$$
「You mean that rift in the dimension?」

474:t_032:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You'd better wash your necks and wait, $$コーウェン$$, $$スティンガー$$. One day I'm going to storm in there and beat you senseless.」

474:t_033:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Sorry, $$甲児$$. But you and $c are going to have to come along for my fight.」

474:t_033:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I guess I'm just happiest when I'm fighting after all.」

474:t_033:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Wouldn't have it any other way!」

474:t_033:3.en:
$$隼人$$
「A fight against $$バアル$$ with the galaxy as the battlefield, huh...」

474:t_033:4.en:
$$弁慶$$
「If we keep tagging along with $$竜馬$$, the scale of this story just keeps getting bigger.」

474:t_033:5.en:
$$竜馬$$
(That's how it is, other me, fighting somewhere out there...)

474:t_033:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
(Even without your calling out to me, I'll come to where you are sooner or later. As long as you keep fighting.)

474:t_033:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
(You and I will both keep living in an eternal fight. Someday, let's meet on the battlefield...)

474:t_034:0.en:
$$渓$$
「$$號$$! $$竜馬$$ is in the Dragon! Somehow dodge its attacks!」

474:t_034:2.en:
$$凱$$
「I'm counting on you, everyone! We can't move from this spot!」

474:t_100:0.en:
$$甲児$$
($$竜馬$$...! This time it's my turn to protect you!)

474:t_100:1.en:
$$甲児$$
(There are still things I want you to teach me! I'm never going to let you die in a place like this!)

474:t_101:0.en:
$$凱$$
「$$竜馬$$! Bear with us just a little!」

474:t_101:1.en:
$$渓$$
「We'll shut down the $$ゲッター$$ right away and save you!」

474:t_101:2.en:
$$號$$
($$インベーダー#pilot$$s and humans are both living things... They're alike in that both make living together their supreme priority.)

474:t_101:3.en:
$$號$$
($$竜馬$$... You're a human being. Go beyond that point...!)

474:t_102:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Damn it! How did things end up like this!?」

474:t_102:2.en:
$$恵子$$
「They're coming at us fully intending to take us down!」

474:t_102:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「Big Bro $$竜馬$$! I was going to challenge you once I got a little stronger, Big Bro, and now we end up fighting like this!」

474:t_102:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「Damn it all! If that's how it is, I'll meet you head-on with everything I've got right now!」

474:t_103:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$流竜馬$$... Will even a man of your caliber fall into darkness...!」

474:t_103:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「You are a strong man! I believe you will turn back from a beast that fights on nothing but instinct and impulse, to a warrior!」

474:t_104:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hold on, $$竜馬$$! We're going to stop you right now!」

474:t_104:1.en:
$$柿小路$$
「$$竜馬$$! I have not forgotten the hunt we did together on the $$暗黒大陸$$!」

474:t_104:2.en:
$$厚井$$
「You're supposed to be a warrior! Stop fighting that's nothing but violence!」

474:t_104:3.en:
$$木下$$
「If it's a contest you want, let's have another drinking contest!」

474:t_104:4.en:
$$郁絵$$
「We'll have your favorite things ready too, $$竜馬$$!」

474:t_104:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「And if that still doesn't stop you, $$トライダー$$ and I will take you on with everything we've got! Bear with it a little, $$竜馬$$!」

474:t_105:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$竜馬$$! You've always shown us what a strong man ought to be!」

474:t_105:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「That's why I'm absolutely going to stop you!」

474:t_105:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Because you taught me that a strong man can put his life on the line for his comrades!!」

474:t_106:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「To think I'd end up fighting $$竜馬$$ again like this...!」

474:t_106:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「But I don't intend to lose! We can't end here!」

474:t_106:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Here I come, $$竜馬$$!! I'm staking everything you taught me on stopping you!!」

474:t_107:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「This surge of killing intent...! So this is $$竜馬$$'s instinct and impulse!」

474:t_107:1.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「Has he been swallowed up by it...!」

474:t_107:2.en:
$$ナオト$$
「That's not like you, being like that!」

474:t_107:3.en:
$$アキラ$$
「You're not the kind of man who loses to something like that!」

474:t_107:4.en:
$$ミカ$$
「Please fight at the head of our group again, like you always do!」

474:t_107:5.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「Go, $$マーズ$$! We have to stop him!」

474:t_107:7.en:
$$タケル$$
「Here I come, $$竜馬$$! I'll take all of your killing intent!」

474:t_107:8.en:
$$タケル$$
「And then I'll have you come back! To the same old $$流竜馬$$ we all look up to!!」

474:t_108:0.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「$$シモン$$! He means business!」

474:t_108:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「Yeah! If he's going all out, so are we! Or we'll get pushed back!」

474:t_108:2.en:
$$ギミー$$
「Don't complain if it hurts, $$竜馬$$!」

474:t_108:3.en:
$$ダリー$$
「In return, we're absolutely going to be the ones to stop you, $$竜馬$$!」

474:t_108:4.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「You're one of our precious comrades! I refuse to lose you right before my eyes!」

474:t_108:5.en:
$$シモン$$
(Bro, lend me your strength! We're up against $$竜馬$$, the $$竜馬$$!)

474:t_108:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「Let's do it! I'm going to hit him with everything I've got, body and soul!!」

474:t_109:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$竜馬$$! I absolutely will not lose! Not when I'm fighting to save you, too!」

474:t_109:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let's see whose flame burns hotter, yours or $$ガンバスター$$'s - it's a showdown!!」

474:t_110:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「He's strong...! I knew it in my head, but I never imagined he'd be this much of a threat as an enemy!」

474:t_110:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Don't give up, Big Sis! Now is the time to burn with effort and guts!」
